title: Transition Delay and Confrontation
key_parties: John Smith, Sarah Jones, Tommy Smith
description: Respondent arrived 45 minutes late for exchange without notice. When Applicant inquired about delay, Respondent shouted profanities.
child_impact: Tommy appeared visibly distressed and withdrew quietly into rear seat.
counsel_notes: Breach of Paragraph 4 of August 12 Interim Order. Preserved dashcam audio.

title: Section 7 Daycare Reimbursement Refusal
description: Applicant requested copies of Sunshine Early Learning Centre receipts to substantiate /mo Section 7 claim. Respondent replied via email: 'You are not getting any receipts until you agree to pay the full amount I asked for.'
counsel_notes: Breach of Park v. Thompson threshold requirement for verified third-party receipts.

title: Parenting Schedule Breach & Weekend Withholding
key_parties: John Smith, Sarah Jones, Tommy Smith
description: Respondent refused to produce Tommy for scheduled Friday 3:30 PM exchange at Guelph Public Library, claiming Tommy had a birthday party. No makeup time offered.
child_impact: Tommy missed scheduled weekend with Father.
counsel_notes: Breach of Paragraph 3(c) and 4(b) of Justice Henderson's Interim Order.

title: Late Arrival via Mobile Jules Intake
description: Mother was 30 minutes late for pickup without notice.
